dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds like fun.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Fantastic! Alright then, who wants to go first?

dialogues.speaker: Inti
dialogues.text: I have a suggestion — ladies first.

dialogues.speaker: Wechtekah
dialogues.text: That's fine by me.

dialogues.speaker: Xoma
dialogues.text: My my, such gentlemen! To tell the truth, I'd like to take a photo with such fine young people as yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Inti
dialogues.text: Huh? A—Alright, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Wechtekah
dialogues.text: Ahem, that's fine by me.

dialogues.speaker: Xoma
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wait, that's not enough. I'd like to add three more young men to the picture. You can manage that, can't you?

dialogues.speaker: Xoma
dialogues.text: Oh, and maybe some fireworks? I used to love that kind of thing when I was your age.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: You got it. Let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Never mind. I've got other things to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a second.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Whew, that was the last one! You two really saved the day for me. If not for your help, I might've been inundated with complaints.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't sweat it, hehe. We're the most helpful adventurers ever!

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Adventurers, huh? How about I take a photo of you two? Let's capture that helpful spirit of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: C'mon, smile for the Kamera! An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer!

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Thank you both once again. And take these as thanks, please.

dialogues.speaker: Xoma
dialogues.text: Everything here seems to be in working condition. Why isn't it open?

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Ah, my apologies. Unfortunately, our set decorator got a little too tipsy last night and couldn't make it to work today. Would you mind dropping by tomorrow instead?

dialogues.speaker: Xoma
dialogues.text: Oh dear, I'm too old to drag these aching bones all the way back here tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Inti
dialogues.text: Not to mention, we've already got plans for tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry. The whole idea of this Summer Photo Booth is to give each customer their own personalized photo background.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: But without our set decorator, we just can't make it happen.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Really? You two are willing to help? That would be amazing! It's not complicated at all — just set up the photo backgrounds based on our customers' requirements.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: That last one turned out great! Next up is this strapping Fatuus. What kind of photo did you have in mind?

dialogues.speaker: Wechtekah
dialogues.text: Please make me look like a sharpshooter. Y'know, one glance and people will know I never miss.

dialogues.speaker: Wechtekah
dialogues.text: That way, it won't matter so much when I rank near the bottom in company marksmanship contests.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: You got it. Let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: That last one turned out great! Finally, we have this dashing young man. What kind of photo did you have in mind?

dialogues.speaker: Inti
dialogues.text: Why, thank you for the compliment. My whole life, I've valued good bearing and grace above all else.

dialogues.speaker: Inti
dialogues.text: Without good bearing, one lacks elegance — and without grace, one lacks refinement. I'm sure you understand my requirements.

dialogues.speaker: Yiztli
dialogues.text: Hmm... Gimme a sec... Got it, let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a second.
